name: Work Sans
summary: Google Fonts specimen page for Work Sans, a grotesque-inspired family for on-screen text with 9 weights.
description: Specimen page for Work Sans on Google Fonts. A family based loosely on early Grotesques (Stephenson Blake, Miller & Richard, Bauerschen Giesserei); the middle weights are optimised for on-screen text at 14-48px, the extreme weights for display. 9 weights (100-900) plus matching italics, variable weight axis, subsets latin, latin-ext and vietnamese; led by type designer Wei Huang; SIL Open Font License 1.1. The specimen page renders with JavaScript, so the facts come from the family's metadata.
